app.name: Dockcrew
app.tagline: Unloading crews for your dock, booked per container.

landing.heroTitle: Container unloading, done by crews that own their work.
landing.heroText: Post a job per container. Verified crews quote within hours. You choose on price and rating. Pay the crew directly.
landing.forSuppliersText: Fixed price per container, by colli band. A compliance file for every crew. No agency margin.
landing.forTeamsText: Quote your own price. Get paid per container, straight to your company's account. Build a rating that wins work.
landing.step1: Supplier posts: containers, colli, date, driver yes or no.
landing.step2: Crews apply or quote within the window.
landing.step3: Supplier picks a crew on price and rating.
landing.step4: Crew unloads and uploads the doclist per container.
landing.step5: Supplier confirms. Invoice is generated. Supplier pays the crew.
landing.region: Starting in the Rotterdam port area.
